title: Copilot reflection and telemetry - pilot
description: Observed chat tokens by project and model, with reviewed assessments and telemetry diagnostics below. Not billing or complete usage accounting.

options.content:
### Project token usage
Observed tokens from deduplicated **chat spans only**, filtered by project and time. Agent/tool spans are excluded from token sums to avoid overlapping totals. Cache reads are shown separately, not added to input tokens.

These are reported observations, **not billing or guaranteed complete usage**. Missing usage is shown in the tables; unresolved projects remain `unattributed`. Assessments and raw telemetry are collapsed below.

panels.title: Observed input tokens
panels.description: Sum of reported input tokens on deduplicated chat spans only. Agent/tool spans are excluded. Missing values are not proof of zero usage; this is not billing.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])
| summarize InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null))

panels.title: Observed output tokens
panels.description: Sum of reported output tokens on deduplicated chat spans only, not overlapping agent/tool spans. Not billing or guaranteed complete usage.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])
| summarize OutputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(OutputTokens)) > 0, sum(OutputTokens), long(null))

panels.title: Observed cache-read tokens
panels.description: Reported cache-read tokens from deduplicated chat spans. Shown separately; never added to input tokens. Missing cache reporting is not treated as zero.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])
| summarize CacheReadTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(CacheReadTokens)) > 0, sum(CacheReadTokens), long(null))

panels.title: Last observed span
panels.description: Latest span start time within the selected range, not collector heartbeat or process health. A historical range can intentionally show an old timestamp.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastSpan=max(TimeGenerated)
| project LastSpan=tolong((LastSpan - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms)

panels.title: Observed tokens over time
panels.description: Input, output, and cache-read observations from deduplicated chat spans, bucketed by span start time. Series are not stacked or added together; cache reads may overlap input.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])
| summarize InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null)), OutputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(OutputTokens)) > 0, sum(OutputTokens), long(null)), CacheReadTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(CacheReadTokens)) > 0, sum(CacheReadTokens), long(null)) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Observed tokens by model
panels.description: Reported chat-span tokens by model for the selected projects. MissingUsage counts chat spans missing input or output; MissingCache counts spans without cache-read reporting. Null totals mean no reported value.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model'])
| extend Model=iff(isempty(Model), '(not reported)', Model)
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])
| summarize ChatSpans=count(), InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null)), OutputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(OutputTokens)) > 0, sum(OutputTokens), long(null)), CacheReadTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(CacheReadTokens)) > 0, sum(CacheReadTokens), long(null)), MissingUsage=countif(isnull(InputTokens) or isnull(OutputTokens)), MissingCache=countif(isnull(CacheReadTokens)) by Model
| order by InputTokens desc

panels.title: Observed tokens by project
panels.description: Chat-span observations only, not billing. MissingUsage counts spans without input or output; MissingCache counts spans without cache-read reporting. Unattributed usage is retained separately. Null totals mean no reported value.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])
| summarize ChatSpans=count(), InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null)), OutputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(OutputTokens)) > 0, sum(OutputTokens), long(null)), CacheReadTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(CacheReadTokens)) > 0, sum(CacheReadTokens), long(null)), MissingUsage=countif(isnull(InputTokens) or isnull(OutputTokens)), MissingCache=countif(isnull(CacheReadTokens)) by ProjectId
| order by InputTokens desc

panels.title: Inspect data | assessments and raw telemetry
Reviewed assessment summaries
panels.description: Latest published reviewed revision per session. No data means no reviewed summaries match these filters; telemetry does not trigger assessment or automatic publishing.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Outcome, Summary, Origin, Limitations, SessionEndedAt
| order by TimeGenerated desc

CopilotAssessments_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Origin != 'synthetic_azure_model_smoke'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId, Revision
| summarize arg_max(Revision, *) by Origin, ProjectId, SessionId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastAssessment=max(TimeGenerated), EligibleRowsVisible=count() by ProjectId, Origin
| extend MinutesSinceAssessment=datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastAssessment)
| order by LastAssessment desc

panels.title: Incoming telemetry - raw spans, not usage totals

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| project TimeGenerated, ProjectId, Attribution=tostring(Attributes['attribution.status']), AttributionReason=tostring(Attributes['attribution.reason']), Operation=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']), Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model']), InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens']), DurationMs, TraceId, SpanId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100

panels.title: Pilot notes | privacy, accounting and analysis scope

options.content:
### Reading the numbers
Token panels sum only deduplicated **chat spans**. Agent and tool totals are excluded to avoid overlap. Cache-read tokens are separate observations, not an extra amount to add to input. Missing fields are not converted into zero totals; MissingUsage and MissingCache expose incomplete reporting. Transport loss, unsupported clients, subagent overlap, and billing reconciliation remain unverified.

Exact approved local session identities determine project aliases. Direct or unresolved spans remain `unattributed`; project selection cannot repair historical rows. Live two-project acceptance remains pending.

Last observed span is data freshness, not process health. The gateway health endpoint checks local reachability, not Azure. Time filters use span start or assessment creation time; lookbacks are capped at 30 and 90 days respectively. Synthetic smoke rows are excluded.

### Metadata only
VS Code Insiders is configured to send metadata from **all projects** after a window reload, with content and identity capture disabled. The local collector filters traces before persistence/upload and discards logs and aggregate metrics.

No prompts, replies, code, tool payloads, or identity fields are permitted in dashboard storage.

### Daily reflection is separate
**Copilot Daily Session Review** processes new archived sessions at **09:00 local time** within an explicitly approved local scope. An approved projects root includes future projects, with no backfill and one shared five-attempt daily budget. The first scheduled assessment is deferred until the next 09:00 run after installation.

Assessments stay local until a derived summary is manually reviewed and published. Published rows describe historical archived revisions, not live source eligibility. Telemetry arriving here does not mean conversations have been analyzed. Check local status for actual enablement and job health.
